name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: The Richard is a double storage bed with no visible feet and a thick low-to-the-floor bed surround. Its edges curve outwards, expanding the supporting base at the bottom, a detail echoed by the curvature of the headboard to suggest a mattress resting upon a raised platform, much like a sculpture. A particular enveloping detail provides an immediate sense of softness and comfort: the rolled effect at the sides of the padded headboard, folded back on itself in two gentle curls that protrude slightly beyond the bed surround. Upholstered in fabric, micro nubuck, synthetic leather or soft leather as per sample card, the bed includes slats, with optional pull-up slats with container available.
